title: Finite twisted inverse image is bounded below
statement: Let $f:X\to Y$ be a finite morphism [def-weil-finite-integral-morphism] of Noetherian schemes [def-pc-scheme] and let $f^!$ be the right adjoint of $Rf_*$ [def-pc-derived-direct-image]. For every $K\in D^+_{\mathrm{QCoh}}(Y)$ [def-pc-derived-category], the object $f^!K$ belongs to $D^+_{\mathrm{QCoh}}(X)$ [def-pc-derived-category].

source.place: Tag 0A9I, lemma-twisted-inverse-image-bounded-below (duality.tex); the finite case is Tag 0AX2, duality-lemma-finite-twisted

proof.text: A finite morphism of Noetherian schemes is quasi-compact and quasi-separated, and its target is quasi-compact. Apply the existing uniform truncation-bound statement [lem-pc-derived-direct-image-uniform-truncation-bound] to a shift of any L\in D_{\mathrm{QCoh}}(X): shifting reduces the case H^i(L)=0 for i>r to the stated case H^i(E)=0 for i>0, and shifting back gives an integer N, independent of r, with Rf_*D^{\le r}_{\mathrm{QCoh}}(X)\subseteq D^{\le r+N}_{\mathrm{QCoh}}(Y).

Choose an integer c with H^i(K)=0 for i\le c, and put A=\tau_{\le c-N}f^!K. By the standard truncation triangle, A lies in D^{\le c-N}_{\mathrm{QCoh}}(X), so Step 1 gives Rf_*A\in D^{\le c}_{\mathrm{QCoh}}(Y), while K lies in D^{\ge c+1}_{\mathrm{QCoh}}(Y). The defining right-adjunction bijection for f^! identifies Hom_X(A,f^!K) with Hom_Y(Rf_*A,K), and this group is zero by [lem-pc-derived-tstructure-orthogonality].

source.place: Tag 0AX2, proof of lemma-twisted-inverse-image-bounded-below, displayed Hom computation

proof.text: The canonical truncation map \tau_{\le c-N}f^!K\to f^!K induces the identity on cohomology in degrees \le c-N. Since the map is zero by Step 2, all cohomology sheaves H^i(f^!K) vanish for i\le c-N. Thus f^!K is bounded below and remains quasi-coherent, so it belongs to D^+_{\mathrm{QCoh}}(X).
